        "Full": "planning-permission",

        "Reserved matters": "approval-of-reserved-matters-following-outline-approval",
    },

import re

ACCOUNTS = {
    "dev":  "pinssts62adevukseftlkl",
    "test": "pinssts62atestuksnkavj4",
    "prod": "pinssts62aproduksrz8i4g",
}

if LOCAL_DIR:
    ENV, ROOT = "local", LOCAL_DIR
else:
    from notebookutils import mssparkutils
    ws = mssparkutils.env.getWorkspaceName().lower()
    m  = re.search(r"(?:^|[-_])(dev|test|prod)(?:[-_]|$)", ws)
    if not m:
        raise ValueError(f"Can't detect env from workspace name '{ws}'")
    ENV  = m.group(1)
    ROOT = f"abfss://s62a@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT or ACCOUNTS[ENV]}.dfs.core.windows.net/PIPELINE"

print(f"ENV={ENV} | ROOT={ROOT}")

import os, re, csv, uuid

          "output": OUTPUT_DIR, "key": STORAGE_KEY}
RUN_TS = datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
TMP    = "/tmp/s62a_schema"
os.makedirs(TMP, exist_ok=True)

PROVISIONAL = {
    "ApplicationType": ["Planning permission", "Outline planning permission with some matters reserved",
                        "Outline planning permission with all matters reserved",
                        "Approval of reserved matters following outline approval",
                        "Planning permission and listed building consent (LBC) for alterations, extension or demolition of a listed building"],
    "ApplicationSubType": ["Planning permission", "Listed building consent"],
    "ApplicationProcedure": ["Written representations", "Hearing"],
}
slug = lambda s: re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", s.lower()).strip("-")
for t, names in PROVISIONAL.items():
    REF[t] = [(slug(n), n) for n in names]

addr = stg["Address"]
out["Address"] = addr[["id", "line1", "line2", "townCity", "county", "postcode"]].to_dict("records")
addr_id = {(r.caseReference, r.addressType): r.id for r in addr.itertuples()}

out["Organisation"], out["Contact"], out["S62aToApplicant"] = [], [], []
has_agent = set()
for r in stg["Contact"].itertuples():
    role_id = resolve("S62aToApplicantRole", r.contactRole, r.caseReference, "S62aToApplicant", "roleId")
    address = addr_id.get((r.caseReference, r.contactRole))
    if role_id == "agent":
        has_agent.add(r.caseReference)
    if not blank(r.orgName):
        org_id = make_guid("Organisation", r.caseReference, r.contactRole, r.orgName)
        out["Organisation"].append({"id": org_id, "name": r.orgName, "addressId": address})
        out["S62aToApplicant"].append({"id": make_guid("S62aToApplicant", org_id), "s62aId": r.caseId,
                                       "organisationId": org_id, "contactId": None, "roleId": role_id})
    if any(not blank(x) for x in (r.firstName, r.lastName, r.email, r.telephoneNumber)):
        out["Contact"].append({"id": r.id, "firstName": r.firstName, "lastName": r.lastName,
                               "telephoneNumber": r.telephoneNumber, "email": r.email, "contactPreferenceId": None,
                               "orgName": r.orgName, "jobTitleOrRole": None,
                               "addressId": address if blank(r.orgName) else None})
        out["S62aToApplicant"].append({"id": make_guid("S62aToApplicant", r.id), "s62aId": r.caseId,
                                       "organisationId": None, "contactId": r.id, "roleId": role_id})

lpa_links = {}
out["Lpa"] = []
placeholder_lpas = {}

def placeholder_lpa(name, ref, column):
    if PLACEHOLDER_LPA_ID:
        log(ref, "S62aCase", column, name, f"No real LPA id yet, linked to existing placeholder Lpa {PLACEHOLDER_LPA_ID}", "INFO")
        return PLACEHOLDER_LPA_ID
    core = re.sub(r"\b(?:city|district|borough|county|metropolitan)?\s*council\b", "", str(name or ""), flags=re.I).strip() or "Unknown LPA"
    key = norm(core)
    if key not in placeholder_lpas:
        placeholder_lpas[key] = {"id": make_guid("LpaPlaceholder", key), "name": f"{core} (migration placeholder)",
                                 "email": None, "telephoneNumber": None, "addressId": None, "pinsCode": None, "onsCode": None}
        out["Lpa"].append(placeholder_lpas[key])
    log(ref, "S62aCase", column, name, "No real LPA id yet, linked to a placeholder Lpa row", "INFO")
    return placeholder_lpas[key]["id"]

for r in stg["S62aCaseLpa"].itertuples():
    column = "lpaId" if r.lpaRole == "Primary" else "secondaryLpaId"
    if lpa_ref is None and USE_PLACEHOLDER_LPAS:
        lpa_id = placeholder_lpa(r.lpa, r.caseReference, column)
    else:
        lpa_id = name_lookup(lpa_ref, r.lpa, r.caseReference, "S62aCase", column)
        if lpa_id is None and USE_PLACEHOLDER_LPAS and not blank(r.lpa):
            lpa_id = placeholder_lpa(r.lpa, r.caseReference, column)
    contact_id = None
    if any(not blank(x) for x in (r.contactName, r.telephoneNumber, r.email)):
        name = r.contactName or ""
        is_org = bool(re.search(r"council|district|borough|authority|planning|team", name, re.I))
        first, _, last = ("", "", "") if is_org else name.partition(" ")
        contact_id = make_guid("LpaContact", r.caseReference, r.lpaRole)
        out["Contact"].append({"id": contact_id, "firstName": first or None, "lastName": last or None,
                               "telephoneNumber": r.telephoneNumber, "email": r.email, "contactPreferenceId": None,
                               "orgName": name if is_org else r.lpa, "jobTitleOrRole": None, "addressId": None})
    lpa_links[(r.caseReference, r.lpaRole)] = (lpa_id, contact_id)

dates = stg["S62aDates"].set_index("caseReference")
notes = stg["S62aCaseNote"]
def type_id_for(r, ref, T):
    if not blank(r["Type"]):
        return resolve("ApplicationType", r["Type"], ref, T, "Type", "PermissionSought", provisional=True)
    if not blank(r["SubType"]):
        hit = LOOKUP["ApplicationType"].get(norm(r["SubType"]))
        if hit:
            log(ref, T, "typeId", r["SubType"], f"No application type, used the subtype instead ({hit})", "INFO")
            return hit
    if DEFAULT_TYPE_ID:
        log(ref, T, "typeId", None, f"No application type or usable subtype, set to default {DEFAULT_TYPE_ID}", "INFO")
        return DEFAULT_TYPE_ID
    return None

out["S62aCase"] = []
for r in stg["S62aCase"].to_dict("records"):
    ref, T = r["caseReference"], "S62aCase"
    unit = resolve("SiteAreaUnit", r["SiteAreaOriginalUnit"], ref, T, "SiteAreaOriginalUnit")
    area = to_num(r["siteAreaInSquareMetres"], ref, T, "siteAreaInSquareMetres")
    if area is not None and unit == "hectares":
        area = round(area * 10000, 2)
    lpa_id, lpa_contact = lpa_links.get((ref, "Primary"), (None, None))
    if lpa_id is None and USE_PLACEHOLDER_LPAS:
        lpa_id = placeholder_lpa("Unknown LPA", ref, "lpaId")
    sec_id, sec_contact = lpa_links.get((ref, "Secondary"), (None, None))
    status_src = r["S62aStatus"]
    expected = r["expectedSubmissionDate"]
    if blank(expected) and EXPECTED_SUBMISSION_FALLBACK and ref in dates.index:
        for c in ("notificationReceivedDate", "applicationReceivedDate", "preApplicationReceivedDate"):
            if not blank(dates.at[ref, c]):
                expected = dates.at[ref, c]
                log(ref, T, "expectedSubmissionDate", expected, f"Missing, filled from S62aDates.{c}", "INFO")
                break
    eia_outcome = r["eiaScreeningOutcome"]
    eia_outcome_bool = None
    if not blank(eia_outcome):
        t = eia_outcome.lower()
        eia_outcome_bool = False if ("neg" in t or "not required" in t or "no screening" in t) else None
        log(ref, T, "eiaScreeningOutcome", eia_outcome,
            "Negative screening -> false (text kept in notes)" if eia_outcome_bool is False
            else "Free text, can't be set to true/false, left null (text kept in notes)",
            "INFO" if eia_outcome_bool is False else "ACTION")
    out["S62aCase"].append({
        "id": r["id"], "reference": ref, "historicalReference": r["historicalReference"],
        "createdDate": r["createdDate"], "updatedDate": None,
        "description": r["description"] or DEFAULT_DESCRIPTION, "likelyIssues": r["likelyIssues"],
        "typeId": type_id_for(r, ref, T),
        "subTypeId": resolve("ApplicationSubType", r["SubType"], ref, T, "SubType", provisional=True),
        "classificationId": resolve("S62aClassification", r["Classification"], ref, T, "Classification"),
        "applicationPhaseId": resolve("S62aApplicationPhase", r["ApplicationPhase"], ref, T, "ApplicationPhase"),
        "s62aStatusId": resolve("S62aStatus", status_src, ref, T, "S62aStatus", "Status"),
        "specialismId": resolve("Specialism", r["Specialism"], ref, T, "Specialism"),
        "stageId": resolve("S62aStage", r["Stage"], ref, T, "Stage"),
        "categoryId": resolve("S62aCategory", r["Category"], ref, T, "Category", "ApplicationType"),
        "procedureId": resolve("ApplicationProcedure", r["Procedure"], ref, T, "Procedure", "Procedure", provisional=True),
        "applicantTypeId": resolve("S62aApplicantType", r["ApplicantType"], ref, T, "ApplicantType"),
        "hasAgent": ref in has_agent,
        "lpaId": lpa_id, "lpaContactId": lpa_contact,
        "hasSecondaryLpa": (ref, "Secondary") in lpa_links,
        "secondaryLpaId": sec_id, "secondaryLpaContactId": sec_contact,
        "inspectorBandId": resolve("InspectorBand", r["InspectorBand"], ref, T, "InspectorBand"),
        "eiaScreening": to_bool(r["eiaScreening"], ref, T, "eiaScreening"),
        "eiaScreeningOutcome": eia_outcome_bool,
        "pressNoticeCost": to_num(r["pressNoticeCost"], ref, T, "pressNoticeCost"),
        "pressNoticePlaced": r["pressNoticePlaced"], "pressNoticeReference": r["pressNoticeReference"],
        "siteAddressId": addr_id.get((ref, "Site")),
        "siteEasting": to_num(r["siteEasting"], ref, T, "siteEasting", integer=True),
        "siteNorthing": to_num(r["siteNorthing"], ref, T, "siteNorthing", integer=True),
        "siteAreaInSquareMetres": area, "siteAreaOriginalUnitId": unit,
        "siteIsVisibleFromPublicLand": to_bool(r["siteIsVisibleFromPublicLand"], ref, T, "siteIsVisibleFromPublicLand"),
        "notificationSubmittedDate": None, "expectedSubmissionDate": expected,
        "representationsPublishDate": r["representationsPublishDate"],
        "representationsPeriodStartDate": r["representationsPeriodStartDate"],
        "representationsPeriodEndDate": r["representationsPeriodEndDate"],
        "lpaReference": r["lpaReference"], "listedBuildingReference": r["listedBuildingReference"],
        "isGreenBelt": to_bool(r["isGreenBelt"], ref, T, "isGreenBelt"), "healthAndSafetyIssue": r["healthAndSafetyIssue"],
        "cilLiable": to_bool(r["cilLiable"], ref, T, "cilLiable"), "cilAmount": to_num(r["cilAmount"], ref, T, "cilAmount"),
        "bngExempt": to_bool(r["bngExempt"], ref, T, "bngExempt"),
        "assessorInspectorId": name_lookup(user_ref, r["AssessorInspector"], ref, T, "assessorInspectorId"),
        "caseOfficerId": name_lookup(user_ref, r["CaseOfficer"], ref, T, "caseOfficerId"),
        "planningOfficerId": name_lookup(user_ref, r["PlanningOfficer"], ref, T, "planningOfficerId"),
        "readerId": name_lookup(user_ref, r["Reader"], ref, T, "readerId"),
        "preApplicationAdviceId": resolve("S62aPreApplicationAdvice", advice_rule(r["PreApplicationAdvice"]) if not blank(r["PreApplicationAdvice"]) else None,
                                          ref, T, "PreApplicationAdvice", "PreApplicationAdviceGiven"),
        "preApplicationReference": r["preApplicationReference"], "preApplicationCaseId": None,
        "outcomeTypeId": resolve("S62aOutcomeType", r["OutcomeType"], ref, T, "OutcomeType"),
        "decisionOutcomeId": resolve("S62aDecisionOutcome", r["DecisionOutcome"], ref, T, "DecisionOutcome", "DecisionType"),
        "wasteActivitiesDescription": r["wasteActivitiesDescription"],
        "isWasteManagementDevelopment": to_bool(r["isWasteManagementDevelopment"], ref, T, "isWasteManagementDevelopment"),
        "updatedById": None,
    })
    if not blank(eia_outcome):
        notes = pd.concat([notes, pd.DataFrame([{"id": make_guid("Note", ref, "eia"), "caseId": r["id"],
                                                 "caseReference": ref, "noteType": "EIA screening outcome",
                                                 "noteText": f"EIA screening outcome: {eia_outcome}"}])])
case_id = {c["reference"]: c["id"] for c in out["S62aCase"]}

out["S62aResidential"], out["S62aResidentialHousing"] = [], []
housing = stg["S62aResidentialHousing"]
combo = {}
for ref, g in housing.groupby("caseReference"):
    res_id = make_guid("S62aResidential", ref)
    out["S62aResidential"].append({"id": res_id, "s62aCaseId": g.caseId.iloc[0], "hasResidentialUnitsChange": True,
                                   "hasExistingHousing": bool((g.housingType == "Existing").any()),
                                   "hasProposedHousing": bool((g.housingType == "Proposed").any())})
    for r in g.to_dict("records"):
        ht = r["housingType"]
        rec = {"id": r["id"], "s62aResidentialId": res_id,
               "housingTypeId": resolve("S62aHousingType", ht, ref, "S62aResidentialHousing", "housingTypeId"),
               "occupancyTypeId": resolve("S62aOccupancyType", r["occupancyType"], ref, "S62aResidentialHousing",
                                          "occupancyTypeId", f"{ht}HousingOccupancyType"),
               "unitTypeId": resolve("S62aUnitType", r["unitType"], ref, "S62aResidentialHousing", "unitTypeId",
                                     f"{ht}HousingUnitType", other_fallback=True)}
        for b in ("bedroomsUnknown", "bedroomsOne", "bedroomsTwo", "bedroomsThree", "bedroomsFourPlus"):
            rec[b] = to_num(r[b], ref, "S62aResidentialHousing", b, integer=True)
        key = (res_id, rec["housingTypeId"], rec["occupancyTypeId"], rec["unitTypeId"])
        if None not in key and key in combo:
            prev = combo[key]
            for b in ("bedroomsUnknown", "bedroomsOne", "bedroomsTwo", "bedroomsThree", "bedroomsFourPlus"):
                prev[b] = (prev[b] or 0) + (rec[b] or 0) if (prev[b] is not None or rec[b] is not None) else None
            log(ref, "S62aResidentialHousing", "unique", key[1:], "Duplicate housing/occupancy/unit combination, counts added together", "INFO")
            continue
        combo[key] = rec
        out["S62aResidentialHousing"].append(rec)

out["S62aNonResidential"], out["S62aNonResidentialFloorspace"], out["S62aNonResidentialFloorspaceArea"] = [], [], []
USE_CLASS_CODES = {"b2": "b2-general-industrial", "b8": "b8-storage-and-distribution", "c1": "c1-hotels",
                   "c2": "c2-residential-institutions", "c2a": "c2a-secure-residential-institutions"}
for ref, g in stg["S62aNonResidentialFloorspace"].groupby("caseReference"):
    nr_id = make_guid("S62aNonResidential", ref)
    out["S62aNonResidential"].append({"id": nr_id, "s62aCaseId": g.caseId.iloc[0], "hasNonResidentialFloorspaceChange": True})
    for r in g.to_dict("records"):
        uc, other_text = r["useClass"], None
        code = re.match(r"^([A-Z]\d+A?)\b", str(uc or ""))
        if blank(uc):
            uc_id = None
            log(ref, "S62aNonResidentialFloorspace", "useClassId", None, "No use class, left null")
        elif code and code.group(1).lower() in USE_CLASS_CODES:
            uc_id = USE_CLASS_CODES[code.group(1).lower()]
        else:
            uc_id = "other"
            if norm(uc) != "other":
                other_text = uc
                log(ref, "S62aNonResidentialFloorspace", "useClassId", uc,
                    "Old use class not in current list, set to 'other' with the original in otherTypeOfUse", "INFO")
        out["S62aNonResidentialFloorspace"].append({"id": r["id"], "s62aNonResidentialId": nr_id, "useClassId": uc_id,
                                                    "useClassSubtypeId": None, "otherTypeOfUse": other_text,
                                                    "hasRoomsChange": None, "roomsLost": None, "roomsProposed": None,
                                                    "netAdditionalRooms": None})
        areas = {f: to_num(r[f], ref, "S62aNonResidentialFloorspaceArea", f, integer=True)
                 for f in ("existingGross", "grossLost", "grossProposed", "netAdditionalGross")}
        if any(v for v in areas.values()):
            out["S62aNonResidentialFloorspaceArea"].append({"id": make_guid("Area", r["id"]), "s62aFloorspaceEntryId": r["id"],
                                                            "floorspaceSetId": "standard", **areas})

out["S62aVehicleParking"] = []
for r in stg["S62aVehicleParking"].to_dict("records"):
    vt = resolve("S62aVehicleParkingCategory", r["vehicleType"], r["caseReference"], "S62aVehicleParking", "vehicleType",
                 "ParkingVehicleType", other_fallback=True)
    out["S62aVehicleParking"].append({
        "id": r["id"], "s62aCaseId": r["caseId"], "vehicleType": vt,
        "otherVehicleType": r["vehicleType"] if vt == "other" and norm(r["vehicleType"]) != "other" else None,
        "existingSpaces": to_num(r["existingSpaces"], r["caseReference"], "S62aVehicleParking", "existingSpaces", integer=True),
        "proposedSpaces": to_num(r["proposedSpaces"], r["caseReference"], "S62aVehicleParking", "proposedSpaces", integer=True)})

out["S62aCaseInspector"], seen = [], set()
for r in stg["S62aCaseInspector"].to_dict("records"):
    uid = name_lookup(user_ref, r["user"], r["caseReference"], "S62aCaseInspector", "userId")
